Quarterback situations

TeamSituation
CLEMGame already played Friday Nov 20 (Clemson 20-10). Trent Pearman started and threw 27 passes, as modeled.
WISHopkins was upgraded from questionable to probable on the Nov 20 Big Ten report, but On3's Pete Nakos reported Wisconsin is expected to start Colton Joseph at Purdue (Milwaukee Journal Sentinel via Yahoo, Nov 21). Medium-high confidence; Fickell has not announced it and Hopkins is available.
MDUnchanged since Thursday: Malik Washington (knee) is questionable, and reports (Zenitz, Nov 18; previews Nov 19-20) say he is practicing and expected to start at USC. No final report found. Medium confidence; Cardell Williams starts if he is not cleared.
SCLaNorris Sellers was not on any of this week's SEC availability reports for Georgia (The State via Yahoo, Nov 19; On3). Medium-high confidence; Beamer has not confirmed, and Sellers was also cleared late before Arkansas and did not play.
MSSTAJ Swann is out, and Parker (Billy) Puckett is projected to start against Tennessee Tech, with freshman Brodie McWhorter also set to play (AP/kmjnow, Nov 20; Lebby on the Wednesday SEC teleconference). Medium confidence for the start; snaps may be split.
PITTUnconfirmed. Holden Geriner is still questionable on the Nov 19 ACC report, and Narduzzi said he starts at Louisville if healthy. No Friday or Saturday update was found. Corey Dailey stays modeled; Geriner starting is a real possibility.
NUAidan Chiles is out for Minnesota (ClutchPoints citing ESPN's Pete Thamel, Nov 18). Nicco Marchiol is the expected starter but has not been formally named. Medium-high confidence; small sample.
OSUJulian Sayin is out (elbow, season) and Luke Fahey stays the starter at Nebraska. No change since Thursday. High confidence.
MSUGame already played Friday Nov 20 (Oregon 45-7). The game data shows Kayd Coffman threw most of Michigan State's passes, not Cam Fancher. No pick needed.
KSURotowire, citing Kellis Robinett of The Wichita Eagle (Nov 16), says Dillon Duff remains the starter at Arizona. No later change found. Medium-high confidence.
IUUnconfirmed. The AP preview (Nov 19) says Cignetti has not named a starter for Washington. Grant Wilson (305 yards vs USC) stays modeled; Josh Hoover starting is a real possibility.
UCLATy Dieffenbach is listed probable and Nico Iamaleava is out (Yahoo preview, Nov 18). High confidence that Dieffenbach starts at Michigan.
TTUThomas Castellanos took a hit to the ribs against Oklahoma State, but McGuire said X-rays were clear and he could have returned (about Nov 15). The Nov 18 Field Level Media preview has him starting at Baylor. Some injury feeds list him questionable. Medium-high confidence.
SYRSteve Angeli is healthy and is the starter at Boston College per this week's previews. The questionable QB on the injury list is a backup. High confidence.
USCJayden Maiava is the starter and is not on the Nov 19 USC injury report for Maryland. The questionable QB on the feed is a backup. High confidence.
NDCJ Carr is Notre Dame's starter and previews for SMU name him with no injury. The QB listed out is a backup. High confidence.
KUIsaiah Marshall is the starter in this week's BYU previews. The questionable QB on the injury list is a backup. High confidence.
SDSUStone Saunders has started the last three games and Sean Lewis said he remains the starter (Rotowire, Nov 9). Jayden Denegal's status for Boise State is not reported this week. Medium-high confidence.
ASUJake Fette has started the last three games while Mikey Keene recovers from a knee injury. No report this week names a different starter for Oklahoma State, so his start is likely but unconfirmed.
BOISMaddux Madsen returned from injury and threw for 371 yards and four touchdowns against Oregon State last week (Yahoo game-day guide). He is the modeled starter for San Diego State, with high confidence.
MICHESPN, CBS Sports (Zenitz) and On3 (Nakos) reported Nov 20-21 that Bryce Underwood is expected to start against UCLA over Tommy Carr, who started the last four games. Not officially announced, and Carr may still play, so medium-high confidence.
TA&MESPN sources and On3's Pete Nakos reported Nov 20 that Texas A&M is expected to bench Marcel Reed and start Brady Hart at Oklahoma. It would be Hart's first career start (small sample), so passing numbers are low confidence.
TCUESPN's Pete Thamel reported Nov 20 that Adam Schobel is expected to make his first career start against Utah; Jaden Craig (ankle) is doubtful on the Big 12 report. Schobel has one career pass attempt, so TCU passing numbers are very low confidence.

Starters on other teams come from the latest game played, skipping anyone listed out, not a confirmed announcement.

Player probabilities are close to honest. Holdout buckets landed within about 3 points of actual hit rates, except the top two, which ran 4 points high. Those high numbers now take a haircut, fit on the same holdout, so that correction has not been tested on new games.

Game lines show no edge. Spread MAE was 11.84 points for the close vs 13.06 for our line. Total MAE was 12.73 vs 13.26, across 291 games. The best-fit weight on our line was negative, so every game side here is a pass.

Prop value is unknown. No college prop lines were available, so no prop EV is claimed. The small sample covers six weeks of one season.

2026 holdout, all markets. Dots near the dashed line mean a forecast of X% hit about X% of the time.

Data gaps

  • Prop lines and prices: none found. Each game gives fair lines and limits instead. Moneyline, spread and total prices are real DraftKings numbers via ESPN.
  • Scheme: no man/zone, coverage shell, blitz or pressure rate, routes, alignment or snap counts exist in free college data. Throw location appears only in games with charted text. Nothing here is inferred from a coach's reputation.
  • Positions: roles come from usage, so tight ends show as WR.
  • Injuries: college has no required injury report. Covers is unofficial, and P(plays) values are assumptions. In the backtest 35% of eligible players did not log a stat, so absences are a large risk.
  • Sample: 2026 only for market-tied testing, because ESPN holds few 2025 lines.

Sources: ESPN, NWS, Covers injuries.

These are estimates, and no selection is guaranteed. After the games, run review_cfb.py to score every forecast (Phase 15).
